description: Send transactional email via Notify (password reset, receipt, magic link, invoice, etc.) with a verified from domain. Use when the user wants production delivery. Prefer html for the body. For non-delivering API rehearsal before domain verification, use send_test_email instead.

from.description: Sender address or Name <email@verified-domain.com>. Production custom from requires a verified domain.

html.description: HTML (or plain text) body. Prefer html; message/text also work.

name: send_email
